sasha: quick note while bringing up orca-72k-int3. short smoke repro shows a deterministic KV key "jump" at a rotary boundary with immediate quality collapse. attaching minimal repro.

sasha: repro (fast):
```bash
./quick_smoke.sh --model orca-72k-int3 --quant int3 --context 73728 --prompt fixtures/repeat_8k.txt --seed 21 --out /tmp/orca.out
```

sasha: tiny log excerpt:
```
[2026-07-01T09:10:11Z] tok=71000 emit="and" kv_idx=71000 fp=0x5e7a phase=0x7ff0
[2026-07-01T09:10:12Z] tok=73726 emit="the" kv_idx=73726 fp=0x6ffd phase=0x7fff
[2026-07-01T09:10:12Z] tok=73727 emit="<STRAY>" kv_idx=73727 fp=0x7003 phase=0x8003  # sudden fingerprint/phase step
```

mike: fp16 baseline (orca-72k-fp16) goes to full context fine. int4-hybrid shows minor drift. int3 reproduces reliably with same seed.

anya: ran kv-dump --range 73720-73730 --phase --hex:
```
73720 key=0xaaaa phase=0x7fec
73726 key=0x6ffd phase=0x7fff
73727 key=0x7003 phase=0x8003  # wrap happens here
73728 key=0x7004 phase=0x8004
```

mike: looks like a RoPE boundary but shifted by model scale. hypothesis: quantized rotary LUT bucket or interpolation has a bad entry at that slot.

ci-bot: auto-eval (mini longctx):
- orca-72k-fp16 : ppl(0-55k)=7.8, ppl(55k-73k)=7.9
- orca-72k-int4 : ppl(0-55k)=8.0, ppl(55k-73k)=8.3
- orca-72k-int3 : ppl(0-55k)=8.2, ppl(55k-73k)=12.6  <-- sharp tail regression (+~54% rel)

anya: triage plan: 1) add a micro repro that forces wrap at low pos (e.g., 512) for fast bisect; 2) compare fp32 vs int3 rotary exponents around the bucket; 3) add a kv-fingerprint assert to tests/regressions/rotary_guard_orca.py and a CI job. I'll open an issue and PR.

sasha: filed INF-6009 with repro, kv-dump and eval summary; PR 1620 adds the mini test + kv assert (wip). assigning to eng-ml/rotary-quant. tagging @mike @anya for review. thanks.
